tools.name: compare_deposit_options
tools.description: Compare observed US savings and CD APYs for a balance, holding period, state, monthly-fee and direct-deposit requirements. Returns sourced facts, unknown/conflicting terms and conditional gross-interest illustrations. Unknown terms never count as a match. No eligibility decision, personalized offer, application or account opening. Use for a multi-constraint deposit comparison; use get_savings_rates/get_cd_rates for simple rate lookups.

balance.description: Starting deposit in USD; no account identifiers needed

horizon_months.description: Illustrative holding period. CD estimates require an exactly matching term

require_no_monthly_fee.description: Require zero monthly maintenance fee without a conditional waiver

require_no_direct_deposit.description: Require the published APY without direct deposit

tools.name: get_savings_rates
tools.description: Current savings APYs: FDIC national average plus rates RateZip observed on institutions' own published rate pages. Every row carries an observation timestamp, source, and staleness status. Optional balance/state/credit_score personalize the results transparently (balance resolves the applicable tier APY; nothing is fabricated). Factual rate data only; does not endorse providers, offer financial advice, open accounts, or submit applications. Pass max_results to cap the number of rows and include_provenance=false for a shorter response.

balance.description: Deposit balance in USD — resolves the applicable tier APY and ranks by what you'd earn

state.description: Two-letter state — adds an availability/eligibility note

credit_score.description: FICO — deposit APYs generally don't vary by credit; returns a clarifying note only

max_results.description: Cap the number of observed rows returned, in the payload's ordering. Omit for all.

include_provenance.description: false omits the per-source provenance block (snapshot ids, attributions); each row keeps its own observed_at and source_url.

tools.name: get_cd_rates
tools.description: Current CD APYs: FDIC national averages by term plus RateZip-observed institution rates (with terms, minimums/conditions, observation timestamps, sources, and staleness status). Pass term_months (e.g. 3, 6, 12, 24, 36, 60) to filter to one term; omit for all terms grouped by term. Factual rate data only; does not endorse providers, offer financial advice, open accounts, or submit applications. If no institution publishes the requested term, the result names the terms that are available. Pass max_results to cap the number of rows and include_provenance=false for a shorter response.

term_months.description: CD term in months to filter to (omit for all terms)

balance.description: Deposit balance in USD — resolves the applicable tier APY and ranks by what you'd earn

state.description: Two-letter state — adds an availability/eligibility note

credit_score.description: FICO — deposit APYs generally don't vary by credit; returns a clarifying note only

max_results.description: Cap the number of observed rows returned, in the payload's ordering. Omit for all.

include_provenance.description: false omits the per-source provenance block (snapshot ids, attributions); each row keeps its own observed_at and source_url.

tools.name: get_rate_watch_report
tools.description: Rank observed deposit APYs and separately labelled money market fund 7-day SEC yields. Compare with a historical snapshot and the latest FOMC decision, watch institutions, and flag threshold crossings. Factual comparisons only.

tools.name: get_mortgage_rates
tools.description: Current mortgage rates grouped by loan type: rates RateZip observed on lenders' own published rate pages, each with note rate, APR, representative-scenario conditions, observation timestamp, source, and staleness status. No third-party national-average benchmark is redistributed. Loan types include '30-year fixed' and 'HELOC'. Pass loan_type to filter to one; omit for all grouped by type. Rates are comparable within the same loan type. Factual rate data only; does not produce personalized quotes, imply approval, or endorse lenders. Pass max_results to cap the number of rows and include_provenance=false for a shorter response.

loan_type.description: Loan type to filter to, e.g. '30-year fixed', '15-year fixed', or 'HELOC'. Omit for all.

loan_amount.description: Loan amount in USD — compares with the 2026 one-unit baseline conforming loan limit; county/unit limits and eligibility require separate verification (does not fabricate a rate)

state.description: Two-letter state — adds an availability/licensing note

credit_score.description: FICO — returns EDUCATIONAL context only; never a fabricated credit-adjusted rate

max_results.description: Cap the number of observed rows returned, in the payload's ordering. Omit for all.

include_provenance.description: false omits the per-source provenance block (snapshot ids, attributions); each row keeps its own observed_at and source_url.

tools.name: compare_home_equity_payments
tools.description: Calculate and compare home equity loan or HELOC monthly payments from explicit caller-supplied amount, note rate and term assumptions. Models fully amortizing repayment, an optional interest-only HELOC draw phase, a repayment rate change and one-time cash/financed fees. Returns both phase payments, payment change and modeled interest/cost totals. No lender quote, eligibility decision, rate selection or APR calculation. Missing fees stay unknown. No personal identifiers needed.

label.description: Short scenario name; do not include personal identifiers.

amount_borrowed.description: USD cash borrowed or initially drawn, excluding any financed fees.

annual_interest_rate_percent.description: Caller-supplied note interest rate, not APR; 8 means 8%. Do not infer a borrower's rate.

repayment_months.description: Number of fully amortizing monthly payments AFTER any interest-only phase.

interest_only_months.description: HELOC only: assumed interest-only draw months, followed by full amortization. No additional draws.

repayment_interest_rate_percent.description: Optional rate-change scenario at the start of repayment after interest-only months. Otherwise the same rate continues.

fees.description: Optional one-time fee assumptions. Omit if unknown; omitted fees are excluded, not represented as confirmed zero.

upfront_cash.description: One-time fees paid in cash, in USD. Enter 0 only if explicitly assumed or confirmed.

financed.description: One-time fees added to the balance, in USD. Do not include these in amount_borrowed.

scenarios.description: One to eight explicit payment assumptions. Ask for missing amount, note rate and term, or clearly agree on hypothetical examples.

tools.name: calculate_deposit_earnings_difference
tools.description: Illustrative annualized earnings difference between two savings APYs for a given balance and horizon. Defaults: current = FDIC national average savings rate, comparison = highest RateZip-observed savings APY. States every omission (taxes, penalties, rate changes, tiers, availability). Illustrative calculation only; not financial advice or an investment allocation recommendation.

current_apy_percent.description: APY the money earns today (%); defaults to the FDIC national average savings rate

comparison_apy_percent.description: APY to compare against (%); defaults to the highest RateZip-observed savings APY

tools.name: get_state_auto_benchmarks
tools.description: Audited 2024-2026 sample auto insurance price spreads and cheapest open-market carrier win counts from 10 official US state insurance department (.gov) publications (53,685 quotes across 1,303 standardized profiles in CA, TX, MD, KY, NV, AL, OK, ND, WV, and DC). Pass a state code/name for one jurisdiction (with official .gov rate-guide URL and top carriers) or omit state for the 10-jurisdiction overview. States without a current carrier-level .gov table return an explicit unavailable explanation and the NAIC state regulator directory. Factual benchmark data only; does not produce personalized quotes or endorse insurers.

state.description: Two-letter US state code or full state name (e.g. 'CA', 'Texas', 'DC'). Omit for the 10-jurisdiction overview.

coverage_type.description: Filter multi-state overview to 'full_coverage' or 'minimum_liability'. Ignored when a specific state is requested.

include_carriers.description: Include top open-market carrier win leaderboard for a requested state (default true).

max_results.description: Cap the number of carrier rows (for a single state) or state rows (for the overview).

tools.name: check_auto_carrier_quality
tools.description: Factual carrier standing lookup for US auto insurers: verified AM Best or Demotech financial strength rating status (active, withdrawn, or not rated), underwriting subsidiary notes, eligibility restrictions, public regulatory context, and direct NAIC Consumer Insurance Search lookup guidance (1.00 baseline). Optionally cross-references presence in RateZip's 10-state .gov pricing study. Carriers outside the verified registry return unknown rather than estimated ratings. Factual reference data only; does not endorse insurers.

carrier_name.description: Auto insurance brand or underwriting company name (e.g. 'First Acceptance', 'GEICO Secure', 'CSAA', 'Tesla Insurance', 'Branch').

state.description: Optional two-letter US state code or state name to cross-reference presence in RateZip's 10-state .gov study.

tools.name: compare_auto_quotes
tools.description: Normalize 1 to 10 caller-supplied auto insurance quotes (monthly, 6-month, or annual, plus optional fees) to annualized and monthly-equivalent cost, rank from lowest to highest, calculate differences against an optional current declarations-page policy, flag coverage downgrades (lower liability limits, higher deductibles, or omitted UM/UIM), and attach verified carrier financial-strength context when recognized. Mathematical comparison of supplied inputs only; does not produce binding offers or endorse insurers.

current_policy.description: Optional current declarations-page policy details used as the apples-to-apples baseline for savings and coverage-downgrade checks.

label.description: Label for current policy (defaults to 'Current policy').

carrier.description: Insurer or underwriting company name (optional; cross-referenced against RateZip's verified carrier quality registry when supplied).

premium_usd.description: Quoted or current policy premium in USD for the specified term_months.

term_months.description: Policy billing/pricing period in months: 6 (semi-annual), 12 (annual), or 1 (monthly).

fees_usd.description: Optional policy, billing, or installment fees in USD charged per term (defaults to 0 when omitted; omitted fees remain unknown if charged by the insurer).

bi_per_person_usd.description: Bodily injury liability limit per person in USD (e.g. 100000 for 100/300/100).

bi_per_accident_usd.description: Bodily injury liability limit per accident in USD (e.g. 300000 for 100/300/100).

pd_limit_usd.description: Property damage liability limit in USD (e.g. 100000 for 100/300/100).

um_uim_included.description: Whether Uninsured/Underinsured Motorist (UM/UIM) coverage is included.

label.description: Short label for this quote (e.g. 'Quote A - CSAA').

carrier.description: Insurer or underwriting company name (optional; cross-referenced against RateZip's verified carrier quality registry when supplied).

premium_usd.description: Quoted or current policy premium in USD for the specified term_months.

term_months.description: Policy billing/pricing period in months: 6 (semi-annual), 12 (annual), or 1 (monthly).

fees_usd.description: Optional policy, billing, or installment fees in USD charged per term (defaults to 0 when omitted; omitted fees remain unknown if charged by the insurer).

bi_per_person_usd.description: Bodily injury liability limit per person in USD (e.g. 100000 for 100/300/100).

bi_per_accident_usd.description: Bodily injury liability limit per accident in USD (e.g. 300000 for 100/300/100).

pd_limit_usd.description: Property damage liability limit in USD (e.g. 100000 for 100/300/100).

um_uim_included.description: Whether Uninsured/Underinsured Motorist (UM/UIM) coverage is included.

quotes.description: One to ten caller-supplied auto insurance quotes to normalize to annualized cost, rank, and audit for coverage differences.
